text_block_list.name: Director Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Attention! I hereby announce the
commencement
of the Tracen
Concentration Card Game Tourney!
The
grand prize is one coupon for a special
meat
lover's course, brought to you by
the cafeteria
staff!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
I shall claim victory—for Brian's sake and
mine!

text_block_list.name: Commentator
text_block_list.text:
Biwa Hayahide is matching cards
masterfully in a
display of incredible
memory! Even Special Week
might be
outmatched!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: ...I can't give up! Meat... Meat...

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Hey, Spe! After you win, we're gonna
throw a
meat fiesta to make up for the
meal you missed!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: ...! The match for this card is riiiiight... here!

text_block_list.name: Commentator
text_block_list.text:
Wow! Special Week has found yet
another pair in
just one try!

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Lady Luck must really be on her side to
keep
matching up cards that haven't
even been turned
over once yet.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
...Or maybe she's just crazy focused from
hunger.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Ah, you're that trainer from the other
day. Sorry,
but spare me the small talk.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: I'm up against Spe next. And the round's about to start, so...

text_block_list.name: Commentator
text_block_list.text:
And now we enter the long-awaited
finals! Give it
up for Special Week, who's
defeated formidable
opponents one
after another to make it here! Will
her
final challenger meet the same fate?

text_block_list.name: Spe's Classmate
text_block_list.text: You got this, Spe! Keep it up!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Grrrowl...

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Uuugh! M-my stomach...

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Looks like you've used up quite a bit of

brainpower. ...Care for a piece of candy?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And so the finals begin, if in a somewhat
less than
dramatic fashion!

text_block_list.name: Commentator
text_block_list.text:
And they're at it! Special Week has her
eyes
closed! Is she going to use that
special power of
hers again?!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Meat... Meat... Meat!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: It's this one! ...Huh?!

text_block_list.name: Commentator
text_block_list.text:
What a shocker! Special Week has failed
to match
the cards for the first time
today! What happened
to all that
momentum from earlier?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: No way! Wh-where'd all my luck go?!

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
What? Not enough sugar to
concentrate? I have
more candy, if ya
want.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Groan... Thank you. Sigh... What's going on?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
In the end, Special Week is unable to
get back in
the groove.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Nakayama Festa emerges the victor and
receives
the grand prize.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Huh?! This is the coupon for the special
meat
lover's course... You're really giving
this to me?!

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
You betcha. Just my way of sayin' thanks
for all
the fun. See ya 'rou—

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Oh, looks like we got an audience. I
can't say
peepin's a respectable pastime.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Huhhh?! Don't be ridiculous! As if I'd
ever dream
of cheating!

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
I didn't want the prize, so I threw her a
bone. All I
really wanted was to throw a
wrench in the
machine.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
That's right. You're as stubborn as they
come,
aren't ya? ...Fine. Listen up, 'cause
I'm only gonna
explain this once.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Do you remember that habit that Spe
has?

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. Not only that, but then she'd say
things to
make herself even hungrier.
choice_data_list: Close your eyes before drawing a card...?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
You know, like, "Meat... I want to eat
meat..." Yadda,
yadda.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Now, I dunno if it was on purpose or not,
but El
mentioned Spe had missed a meal.
I bet she
hadn't eaten since breakfast.
She must've been
starvin'.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
As she got hungrier and hungrier, her
gut instincts
got sharper and sharper.
That's exactly what led
to her bout of
good luck.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
So I think to myself, what if we were to
take care
of that hunger? With, say, I
dunno... a piece of
candy.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Things get a little out of whack. A cog
jams in the
machine. A hint of distress
starts to eat away at
those gut instincts
which have been drawing out
such
insane luck.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Relyin' on luck is for suckers. Sometimes
you
gotta use your noggin.
choice_data_list: So what you actually did was...
So what you actually did was...
